messages:
ella (Docs): Hi all I'm opening a small PR to tidy the starter Quickstart. Goal: replace legacy cURL examples, add a small "Playground" section showing fetch + ephemeral token, and add a 1-paragraph "First deploy" checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13021 sam (Eng): Nice. Two runtime notes: param `max_output_tokens` should be `max_tokens` in examples, and streaming SSE path is `/v1/responses/stream`. Also new recommended header `x-rw-client-ver`. rio (DevEx): For the Playground, do we show a browser fetch sandbox + a node dev-proxy? I can craft a tiny in-browser snippet that hits our /playground endpoint and uses ephemeral creds from a prompt (not env). Also recommend not to commit tokens. ella (Docs): Yes show both. Browser snippet should be copy-paste friendly (no build step), and the node proxy should be a one-file example. Add a short callout: "Examples assume Hosted API unless noted." sam (Eng): Also update the TypeScript SDK sample: method changed from `client.responses.create(...)` to `client.responses.generate(...)`. That broke a user's sample yesterday. rio (DevEx): Draft browser snippet for the Playground to add to the quickstart README: ```html 

```

ella (Docs): Perfect. For the node proxy, use env var REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN and bump sample Docker base to `node:20-alpine`. CI likes that.

sam (Eng): Confirmed node:20-alpine is fine. Also mention Dedicated WS host pattern for first deploy notes (ws://dedicated-.redwood.net) and add KMS mention for Private customers.

build-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-13021--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app  lint + linkcheck running.

rio (DevEx): Small nit: old docs still referenced `/docs/private/onprem` in one place. I'll patch to `/docs/private/getting-started` in a follow-up commit.

ella (Docs): I'll include a Migration note in the changelog: "If your prompts use `max_output_tokens` replace with `max_tokens`" and a short note about `nucleus_sampling` -> `top_p` mapping.

sam (Eng): Ran snippet-tests locally against staging runtime. Browser fetch + node proxy + SDK generate all green. No breaking changes.

build-bot: CI passed for PR 13021  preview: https://deploy-preview-13021--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app

ella (Docs): Merging now. Thanks for the quick review everyone! I'll follow up with a tiny tweet and an internal changelog entry. :tada:
